title: Training Note: Share of the Sale Line Sent Back on Northgate Purchases & Returns Business Returns
content:
This training note covers one element of the business restocking charge that Northgate Purchases & Returns invoices on a changed-mind return of special-order merchandise for a Northgate Business Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership: the share of the sale line being sent back.

## The rule

Share of the sale line sent back: when the units on the authorization are half or more of the units sold on that sale line, 2 percentage points are added to the business restocking rate; when they are a quarter or more but less than half, 1 point is added; otherwise nothing is added.

The units on the authorization are those on the return authorization the member is confirming; the units sold are the quantity sold on the sale line that authorization covers.

## Questions answered by the rule

- *What counts as "half or more"?* Units on the authorization at least equal to half of the units sold. On a line of 8 units sold, 4 units is half, so 2 points are added.
- *And between a quarter and half?* On the same 8-unit line, 2 or 3 units are a quarter or more but less than half: 1 point is added.
- *Below a quarter?* 1 unit of 8 is less than a quarter: nothing is added.
- *A single-unit line?* Returning its 1 unit is all of it, half or more: 2 points are added.

| Units sold on the line | Units on the authorization | Share | Points added to the rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | 4 | one half | 2 |
| 8 | 3 | three eighths | 1 |
| 8 | 2 | one quarter | 1 |
| 8 | 1 | one eighth | 0 |
| 10 | 5 | one half | 2 |
| 10 | 2 | one fifth | 0 |

The figures in the table are hypothetical lines.
